description: The chart illustrates the distribution of values across five bins, showing the percentage (proportion) of observations falling into each interval and marking a mean value. The horizontal axis contains the binned categories spanning from 0.0 to 1.0 (linear scale), with visible bin edges at approximately 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0; the axis label is not shown. The vertical axis is labeled “Percentage” and uses a linear scale from 0.0 up to about 0.8, with regularly spaced tick marks at roughly 0.1 intervals. There are five light-blue bars with black outlines: the 0.0–0.2 bin is labeled 11.2%, the 0.2–0.4 bin is labeled 3.4%, the 0.4–0.6 bin is labeled 3.4%, the 0.6–0.8 bin is labeled 5.8%, and the 0.8–1.0 bin is labeled 76.2% (the tallest bar, reaching about 0.762 on the y-axis). A red dashed vertical line is drawn near x ≈ 0.82 and annotated in red text as “mean: 0.82.” The bars appear ordered by increasing bin range from left to right, and no additional grouping, stacking, legend, or special emphasis beyond the percentage labels and the mean line is shown.
